review.notes: A bridge narrative that prepares the in-place crow story (s0c-02) without retelling it: Aman prepares a school game with a water pot and pebbles, and Nani promises a story. Present tense with a few perfective forms (अमन ने घड़ा देखा; कंकड़ डाले). फिर is read correctly in running text ("फिर वह ..."). ढूँढ़ना is written with the nukta in the lemma; the adapter reads ढूँढता / ढूँढा as the same lemma. Words outside the plan (measured): none.

sentences.text: अमन के स्कूल में परसों एक सभा है।
sentences.english: Aman has a school event the day after tomorrow.
Aman is preparing for it.
He goes to the kitchen.
There is a water pot in the kitchen.
The pot is half full of water.

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "अमन, तुम्हारी योजना क्या है?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Aman, what is your plan?"

sentences.text: अमन बोलता है, "मैं घड़े में कंकड़ डालूँगा।"
sentences.english: Aman says, "I will put pebbles into the pot."
Sam says, "Where are the pebbles?"
Aman says, "I will look for them."
Aman goes to the field.
He searches.
There are none in the field.

sentences.text: फिर वह गली में जाता है।
sentences.english: Then he goes into the lane.
There is a house in the lane.
This neighbourhood is not big.
The wall of the house is white.

sentences.text: अमन ढूँढ़ता है, लेकिन वहाँ भी नहीं हैं।
sentences.english: Aman looks, but there are none there either.

sentences.text: फिर वह पुल के सामने जाता है।
sentences.english: Then he goes to the front of the bridge.

sentences.text: पुल के पीछे बहुत कंकड़ हैं!
sentences.english: Behind the bridge there are many pebbles!
Aman picked up a lot.

sentences.text: वह थैले में बहुत डालता है।
sentences.english: He puts a lot into the bag.
He comes home.
The clock says four.
Nani is in the kitchen.

sentences.text: अमन थैला मेज़ पर लाता है।
sentences.english: Aman brings the bag to the table.
He looked.
Aman put them in.
The water becomes more.

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "अमन, यह बहुत अच्छी योजना है!"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Aman, this is a very good plan!"

sentences.text: अमन बोलता है, "सैम, मेरे पास समय नहीं है। मैं रवि सर को फ़ोन करता हूँ।"
sentences.english: Aman says, "Sam, I do not have time. I am phoning Ravi sir."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "यह मेरा मोबाइल है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "This is my mobile."
Aman looks at the number.
Aman makes the call.

sentences.text: अमन बोलता है, "सर, कल आप आइए।"
sentences.english: Aman says, "Sir, come tomorrow."

sentences.text: रवि सर अगले हफ़्ते ट्रेन से गाँव जाएँगे।
sentences.english: Ravi sir will go to the village by train next week.

sentences.text: नानी बोलती हैं, "अमन, यह बहुत अच्छा है।"
sentences.english: Nani says, "Aman, this is very good."

sentences.text: नानी बोलती हैं, "मैं तुम्हें एक कहानी सुनाऊँगी।"
sentences.english: Nani says, "I will tell you a story."
Aman says, "What is the story?"

sentences.text: नानी बोलती हैं, "एक कौए की कहानी।"
sentences.english: Nani says, "A story about a crow."
Sam says, "Nani, tell the story!"

sentences.text: नानी बोलती हैं, "शाम को मैं कहानी सुनाऊँगी।"
sentences.english: Nani says, "In the evening I will tell the story."
Aman stays awake today too.
He listens to the story.
Then he falls asleep.
